messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT] infer-usw-3: 3 nodes NotReady in inference-pool (alerts: kubelet heartbeat lost). Severity: P1. Pager sent to #eng-oncall.
jamie_oncall: ack — taking incident. Starting runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/infer-node-notready
jamie_oncall: quick check: are customer-facing routes impacted? Anyone seeing 5xx spikes?
taylor_prodops: yes — spikes in 503s for hosted api key org-org-42, small % of traffic (~0.4%). Saw latency tail up to 1.2s.
sara_sre: looking at autoscaler + routing, adding emergency replica to inference deployment, +2 replicas now.
mike_infra: getting node list: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=inference -o wide` -> node-infer-03 NotReady, node-infer-07 NotReady, node-infer-09 NotReady. Kernel messages show `kernel: NMI watchdog: BUG` on node-infer-07.
lee_devops: pulling kubelet logs from node-infer-07: `journalctl -u kubelet -n 200` -> repeated `E: failed to sync pod status: context deadline exceeded` then `kubelet: runtime-cni: failed to setup network`.
mike_infra: restarting kubelet on node-infer-07 (ssh then `sudo systemctl restart kubelet`) — restarting node-infer-07 now :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
jamie_oncall: routing: diverting new requests away from infer-usw-3, applying routing rule to prefer infer-usw-1/2. taylor, confirm client retries ok.
taylor_prodops: confirmed, applying route shift, should reduce customer 503s within 30s.
mike_infra: kubelet on node-infer-07 came back but node still NotReady — running `kubelet --v=4` capture, found CUDA driver segfaults in dmesg: `nvidia: GPU watchdog` causing pods to crash.
sara_sre: cordoning node-infer-07 and draining non-critical pods: `kubectl cordon node-infer-07`, `kubectl drain node-infer-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
lee_devops: isolating affected GPU pods, scaling inference replica to cover load. Also applied temporary fallback to CPU variants for low-priority routes.
mike_infra: nodes node-infer-03 and -09 also showing sporadic kubelet restarts — pushing kernel param changes and upgrading NVIDIA driver on a patch cluster. I'll run driver restart on a single node to validate.
jamie_oncall: good. Record customer impact: small % of requests 503/latency spike; no full outage. Paging will continue until pool healthy. :white_check_mark: 
incident-bot: Action log — runbook step 3 executed (cordon & drain), runbook owner: jamie_oncall.
taylor_prodops: notified affected customers via status page with interim mitigation note.
mike_infra: driver restart validated on node-infer-07, node rejoined Ready. node-infer-03 still flaky, working on repro. Rolling reboot planned for node-infer-03 during maintenance window in 15m.
jamie_oncall: handing off to mike_infra for remediation and post-incident follow-up. I'm lowering pager priority. Oncall handover to next shift: @sara_sre takes monitoring for next 2 hours.
sara_sre: ack, monitoring dashboards for infer-usw-3 at +2h. I'll start a postmortem ticket and include logs.
lee_devops: filed PR to add GPU-driver healthcheck to cluster e2e tests.
jamie_oncall: incident status: mitigated — inference pool routes shifted and nodes recovered, customer impact reduced to background noise. Closing pager. Please file full incident writeup and timeline.
